title: Senior Ai Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

- Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

- Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

- Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

- Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

- Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

- Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

- Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

- Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

- Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

- Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

- 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

- You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

- You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

- You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

- You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

- You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

- You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

- You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

- You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

- You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

- You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

- You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

- You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

- You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

- You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Técnico De Telecomunicações - Campo
description:
Closer to Space, Closer to the Future: venha para a Telespazio!

A Telespazio, joint venture entre Leonardo (67%) e Thales (33%), é uma líder global no setor de soluções e serviços satelitais. Fundada na Itália em 1961 e com sede em Roma, a empresa faz parte da Space Alliance, uma colaboração estratégica com a Thales Alenia Space que oferece uma ampla gama de serviços espaciais avançados.

Com mais de 3.300 profissionais distribuídos entre suas filiais na Europa e América Latina, a Telespazio opera uma rede internacional de Centros Espaciais e Teleportos, fornecendo soluções inovadoras nas áreas de Geoinformação, Sistemas e Operações Satelitais e Comunicações via Satélite.

Junte-se a nós enquanto continuamos a ultrapassar os limites do possível no espaço!

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Telecomunicações – Campo para atuar no suporte presencial às operações da Telespazio, em ambiente de telecomunicações e comunicação via satélite. O profissional será responsável por realizar atendimentos técnicos nas estações, executando atividades de instalação, manutenção, inspeção, diagnóstico e resolução de ocorrências, garantindo o atendimento aos chamados dentro dos níveis de serviço estabelecidos e apoiando as atividades operacionais da área.

Residir em Brasília/DF, preferencialmente próximo à região do Lago Sul , com fácil deslocamento até o local de atuação.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender chamados técnicos em campo conforme prioridade e SLA definidos.
  • Realizar inspeções, testes, diagnósticos e manutenção nos equipamentos e infraestrutura das estações.
  • Executar instalação, substituição e remoção de equipamentos, módulos, cabos, conectores e acessórios.
  • Apoiar atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Executar medições elétricas, de conectividade e RF utilizando instrumentos apropriados.
  • Atuar em sistemas de comunicação via satélite, controle, gerenciamento e supervisão remota.

title: Operations Deputy Director
description:
Position: Operations Deputy Director
Direct Reports: 5 Managers
Reports to: General Director
Main Responsibility Areas: Mine Operation, Processing Plant Operation, Maintenance Management and Technical Services.
About the Company
Our client is a global mining company focused on the exploration, development, and production of copper and gold. As part of an international industrial group with operations across multiple countries, the company is committed to operational excellence, sustainable growth, and responsible mining practices.
In Brazil, the company operates one of the country's most important copper mining assets, in the North region—one of the world's premier mining regions. The operation includes both mining and processing facilities and is supported by a highly skilled workforce dedicated to delivering safe, efficient, and sustainable production.
The organization places a strong emphasis on safety, environmental stewardship, innovation, and continuous improvement while fostering a collaborative culture that values people development and high performance.
The Operations Deputy Director will play a key leadership role, overseeing mining and processing activities, driving operational performance, ensuring the highest safety standards, and contributing to the long-term growth and success of the operation.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES
Responsible for overseeing all on-site operational activities, ensuring compliance with internal control and corporate governance standards, delivering short-term production objectives, and maintaining the highest standards of health, safety, environment, quality, and productivity.


  • Plan, operate, maintain and control all mining and ore processing activities.
  • Guarantee the quality and volume of expected production, meeting the sales plan and guaranteeing the product to the end customer.
  • Manage KPIs and support leaders to achieve budgetary and production goals, focusing on continuous improvement, safety management, environmental and social programs.
  • Ensure asset performance by improving operations, capturing cost reductions through process redesign and performance management.
  • Develop and execute the strategic planning of the Carajás Hub to increase the profitability, productivity and efficiency of operations.
  • Develop a high-performance culture and a consistent and sustainable team.
  • Ensure the implementation and alignment of internal corporate policies and practices in the management of operations under their responsibility.
  • Develop and ensure the execution of the operational readiness plan for new assets that will come into operation.
  • Ensure that the operational workforce is informed about direction and goals through a coordinated communication and engagement plan, involving regular briefings and team meetings.

REQUIREMENTS:
  • At least 15 years of experience in leadership positions, experience in managing operation and maintenance leaders in underground mines and processing plants;
  • Experience inmining operations, particularly in underground mines and industrial plants;
    Bachelor's degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, or related fields;
    Fluent English.
  • Experience in large and medium-sized multinational mining companies;
  • Leadership and communication skills, excellent writing and fluent expression;
    Excellent planning, data analysis and organizational skills;
    Proactive attitude focused on anticipating and solving complex problems. Postgraduate degree in Business Management or Human Resources Management.

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm
  • Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience in the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Railways Specialist
description:
Senior Non-Key Expert – Railways Specialist

About NTU International A/S

NTU International A/S is a leading international consulting company providing project management and technical advisory services worldwide. NTU works extensively with European Union institutions, international financial institutions, development agencies, and public sector clients across transport, infrastructure, urban development, climate resilience, governance, and sustainable investment.

NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Global Gateway Transport and Urban Facility 2 – EC-INTPA/2026/EA-RP/0006.”

The overall objective of the project is to support the global transition towards inclusive, smart, clean, safe, secure, resilient and sustainable transport and cities in partner countries, in line with the Global Gateway strategy and the European Green Deal ’ s geopolitical offer .

The contract will require the mobilisation of experts for technical assistance missions worldwide, with a particular focus on Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Asia and the Pacific .

The intended start date is January 2027 , with an implementation period of 48 months .

In this context, NTU International is seeking a highly qualified Senior Non-Key Expert – Railways Specialist to support technical, policy, institutional and investment-related assignments in the railway sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the identification, preparation and implementation of railway infrastructure and systems projects.
  • Conducting feasibility studies, technical assessments, project design reviews and investment-related analyses.
  • Supporting railway planning, corridor development, operations planning and multimodal integration.
  • Advising on rail infrastructure, signalling, interoperability, traffic management and safety systems.
  • Supporting procurement, tendering, implementation supervision, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Promoting sustainable, low-carbon and climate-resilient railway infrastructure and services.
  • Supporting the application and adoption of European and international railway standards and good practices.
  • Advising on interoperability, including relevant EU standards and systems such as ERTMS , where applicable.
  • Contributing to environmental and social assessments, climate resilience and sustainability considerations in railway investments.
  • Supporting policy, regulatory and institutional reforms in the railway sector.
  • Providing capacity building and technical assistance to public authorities, infrastructure managers, operators and other sector stakeholders.
  • Coordinating with public authorities, railway infrastructure managers, operators, contractors, supervising engineers, IFIs and development partners.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Master’s degree or equivalent diploma in railway engineering, civil engineering, transport engineering, transport operations , or another directly related discipline.
  • Excellent knowledge of the railway sector, including rail infrastructure, rail operations, interoperability, safety, and related policies and international good practices.
  • Knowledge of development aid delivery methods.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent computer skills.

General Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years of general professional experience in the railway sector.
  • Proven experience managing complex assignments involving multiple stakeholders, including public authorities, infrastructure managers, operators, contractors, supervising engineers and development partners.
  • Proven professional experience across the project cycle of railway infrastructure and systems investments, including feasibility studies, detailed design, tendering/procurement support, implementation, operation and maintenance planning.
  • Experience applying international and European standards and good practices related to railway infrastructure and systems delivery, including technical quality, safety, environmental and social compliance, and sustainability considerations.

Specific Professional Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in the planning, design, supervision or management of railway infrastructure, systems or operations.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in railway projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America or Asia .
  • Professional experience in the different aspects related to the G20 Principles for Quality Infrastructure in the rail sector, in particular on the technical side, such as feasibility studies, project design, rail operations, interoperability, safety, social and environmental issues, maintenance, procurement, etc.

Assets

  • Professional experience in the Sub-Saharan Africa region (in situ).
  • Professional experience in providing support to governance / capacity building in the rail sector.
  • Professional experience with the EU rules and procedures.

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency at C1 level is mandatory.
  • French at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.
  • Spanish at minimum B2 level will be considered an asset.

Please note that inclusion in the expert pool does not guarantee immediate assignment. Experts will be contacted based on specific project requirements, availability and matching qualifications. Selected experts may be mobilised for short-term technical assistance missions in partner countries globally. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Head Of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety;
    disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Video Editor
description:

------

title: Analista De Finops Pl, Remoto.

title: Data Specialist (With Advanced English)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

About the Role:

We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.

to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!

As Our Data Specialist, you will:

  • Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it.
  • Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here.
  • Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world.
  • Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and PySpark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors
  • You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter
  • You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized
  • You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Email Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As an Email Designer at Lilo Social, you will be the creative force behind high-converting email experiences for our portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will transform strategic concepts into beautiful, mobile-optimized email designs that drive engagement, revenue, and long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with retention strategists and copywriters, you will craft email templates that balance brand aesthetics with performance-driven design principles.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high email engagement rates (open rates, click rates) across your client portfolio through strong visual design
  • Efficient production workflows that allow rapid iteration and testing of design variations
  • Email designs that maintain brand consistency while optimizing for conversion and user experience
  • Positive client feedback on design quality and strong collaboration with cross-functional team members

Responsibilities

  • Create campaign emails, automated flow templates, and promotional designs aligned with client brand guidelines
  • Develop mobile-first email designs that render flawlessly across email clients and devices
  • Collaborate with retention strategists and copywriters to bring campaign concepts to life
  • Iterate quickly on email designs based on performance data and A/B test results
  • Maintain organized design systems and asset libraries for each client account
  • Build reusable email modules and components that streamline production
  • Ensure all emails meet accessibility standards and deliverability best practices
  • Stay current on email design trends, platform updates, and industry innovations
  • Execute QA testing across multiple email clients before campaign launches
  • Support the team with design feedback and contribute to internal design standards
  • Manage multiple client accounts with varying design needs and brand aesthetics

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of experience in email design, digital design, or related field with a strong portfolio demonstrating email work
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for designing email layouts and creating design systems
  • Strong grasp of email marketing best practices including mobile optimization, CTA placement, and visual hierarchy
  • Demonstrated ability to design for conversion while maintaining brand integrity and aesthetic quality
  • Fast iteration speed with ability to produce high-quality work under tight timelines
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across devices
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with strategists, copywriters, and account teams
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer brands and ecommerce customer lifecycle marketing

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or other email service platforms (Mailchimp, Iterable, Braze)
  • Motion graphics or animation capabilities to enhance email interactivity and engagement
  • Experience designing for SMS, push notifications, or other retention marketing channels
  • Understanding of email deliverability factors and how design choices impact inbox placement

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Regional Sales Director
description:
As the Regional Sales Director LATAM , you will be responsible for building the regional go-to-market (GTM) strategy and driving all commercial activities across LATAM. Your initial priority will be to accelerate GMS's growth in Brazil , while laying the foundation for further expansion across the region.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you will take ownership of regional growth, develop executive relationships with Mobile Network Operators, and identify new opportunities to expand GMS's presence across LATAM.

The qualified individual will be responsible for driving revenue growth, winning strategic partnerships, and positioning GMS as the preferred communications solutions partner across the region.

Only candidates with proven experience selling to Mobile Network Operators across LATAM will be considered for this position.

Who we are

GMS is the AI-driven communications solutions partner for Mobile Network Operators and Enterprises globally. Our vision is to become the leading creator of value in the communication world. Together with our clients we identify growth opportunities and co-create secure, engaging AI-driven communications solutions that build trust between brands and their audiences, enabling next-generation customer experiences. We are the strategic partner of choice, ready to greenlight tomorrow.

What you'll do

  • Own and execute the commercial strategy for LATAM, with an initial focus on accelerating business growth in Brazil.
  • Drive regional expansion by identifying new commercial opportunities and bringing new Mobile Network Operators and strategic partners into the GMS ecosystem.
  • Build and manage executive relationships with leading Mobile Network Operators, carriers, and key telecom stakeholders across LATAM.
  • Lead commercial negotiations and close high-value agreements across GMS's portfolio, including messaging, network protection, firewall, and other communications solutions.
  • Develop joint go-to-market initiatives with customers and partners to accelerate business growth.
  • Own the regional sales pipeline, forecasts, revenue performance, and margin targets.
  • Work closely with technical, legal, operations, and delivery teams to ensure successful customer onboarding and solution delivery.
  • Monitor market trends, regulatory developments, and competitive activity to identify new growth opportunities and proactively respond to market changes.
  • Represent GMS at industry events, conferences, and operator forums, strengthening the company's visibility and market position.
  • Mentor and support the development of the regional commercial team while fostering a high-performance sales culture.

What we expect

  • 10+ years of progressive B2B sales and business development experience within the telecommunications industry.
  • At least 3–5 years in a senior commercial or director-level role managing direct relationships with Mobile Network Operators across multiple LATAM markets.
  • Proven track record of winning and closing complex, high-value commercial agreements.
  • Strong understanding of the LATAM telecommunications ecosystem, including Mobile Network Operators, carriers, messaging services, network security, firewall, or related telecom solutions.
  • Established executive network across Mobile Network Operators in LATAM.
  • Strong commercial acumen with excellent negotiation, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical, legal, operations, and delivery teams.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office, and sales forecasting tools.
  • Native or fluent Portuguese and fluent English are required.
  • Spanish is a strong advantage.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across LATAM and internationally.
  • Based in Brazil or another key LATAM location.

What we offer

  • Multicultural & dynamic environment in a fast-growing worldwide business.
  • One-of-a-kind company culture – a mixture of open mindset, high dedication, striving for success, and team spirit.
  • Professional team that is committed and stands for the highest standards of performance.
  • Our values – Integrity, Agility, and Commitment – are vivid in day-to-day company activities.
  • Customer-oriented culture with high respect for both internal and external customers.
  • Competitive salary and bonus system.

Choosing GMS, you greenlight tomorrow!

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)

Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week

About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.

Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems);
    willingness and abilityto learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage;
    identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased;
    audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution

title: Consultor(A) De Implantação E Sucesso Do Cliente Sênior - Latam
description:
Se sente que já domina o técnico, mas quer usar isso em algo maior do que fechar mais um balanço, essa vaga é sobre isso.

Você vai liderar a implantação dos clientes mais complexos da nossa carteira: empresas de capital aberto e fechado que publicam demonstrações financeiras e precisam de consolidação de verdade. Não é suporte, não é operação. É você junto com o cliente desenhando como a informação financeira dele vai funcionar dentro da plataforma.

O que você vai fazer

  • Ser o principal responsável técnico pela implantação dos clientes de alta complexidade do nosso canal estratégico.
  • Elaborar e revisar o layout do cliente na plataforma com total autonomia. É aqui que você traduz o plano de contas, a estrutura societária e as regras de consolidação da empresa em algo que funciona de verdade
  • Montar o cronograma de implantação e defender os prazos junto ao cliente, com revisão do Coordenador
  • Acompanhar o cliente até a conferência dos saldos consolidados e convertidos. Você não entrega e some, você fica até o número fechar
  • Elaborar DFC, DMPL e DVA em cases complexos, de empresas com demonstrações financeiras publicadas, capital aberto e fechado
  • Aplicar CPC, IFRS e consolidação em estruturas societárias que a maioria dos profissionais nunca viu de perto, incluindo conversão de moeda e múltiplas entidades
  • Participar das reuniões de decisão do projeto junto ao cliente, alinhado com o Coordenador. Você fala direto com controller, CFO e diretoria, e a sua leitura técnica faz diferença na conversa
  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes complexos, priorizando, negociando escopo e sustentando a relação ao longo do projeto
  • Gerenciar sua carteira de clientes complexos de ponta a ponta, com autonomia para priorizar, negociar escopo e sustentar a relação depois que o projeto vira. O cliente continua sendo seu
  • Monitorar o risco de cada conta com método, olhando adoção da plataforma, frequência de uso, troca de interlocutor e sinais de insatisfação. Risco identificado cedo é problema resolvido, risco identificado tarde é cliente perdido
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas com o cliente, mostrando o que a plataforma já entregou de resultado e o que ainda dá para destravar. É a conversa que renova a relação todo ciclo
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão dentro da conta, novas empresas do grupo, novos módulos, novos times que podem usar. Você enxerga antes porque conhece a estrutura por dentro;

O queprecisamos que você tenha

  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas
  • Domínio de CPC, IFRS e normas do CFC
  • Conhecimento avançado em consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras
  • Experiência real conduzindo projetos, não só participando deles
  • Excel e Word em nível avançado
  • Espanhol fluente. Requisito obrigatório , você vai conduzir reuniões e projetos nesse idioma;

Por que essa vaga é diferente

  • Tecnologia de verdade: você trabalha dentro de uma plataforma, não de uma planilha. O conhecimento técnico que você levou anos construindo vira produto, processo e escala
  • Temas estratégicos do mercado financeiro: consolidação multiempresa, conversão de moeda, estrutura de capital, tudo o que o setor olha de perto
  • IA aplicada a finanças: você vai estar perto do que existe de mais atual. Estamos construindo isso na prática, com quem entende de contabilidade participando das decisões, não recebendo o resultado pronto
  • Autonomia real: senioridade aqui significa decidir, não pedir aprovação para cada passo

title: Technical Lead
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes overseeing data annotation teams and workflows to maintain the highest levels of dataset integrity and quality. This will primarily involve auditing annotation outputs, onboarding and mentoring new hires, and analyzing datasets to identify trends or anomalies. This person must be able to translate complex technical concepts, manage project timelines, and provide data-driven insights to improve the internal annotation platform. Finding those who are sharp, highly analytical, and can bridge the gap between technical workflows and team performance would be a great fit for the role! Data architecture and workflow optimization are a huge plus!

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Assist in overseeing both the existing data annotation team and new hires.
  • Support project management activities, including new hire onboarding and performance monitoring.
  • Contribute technical feedback to aid in the development of the internal annotation platform and data annotation workflows.
  • Provide guidance, training, and knowledge transfer to data annotators to maximize performance. Conduct or audit Quality Assurance (QA) processes to ensure dataset consistency and high quality. Support the interviewing of data annotators and assist with project onboarding.
  • Proactively identify challenges and trends, and suggest effective solutions for data quality, throughput, and resource allocation issues.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of annotation processes, procedures, and best practices. Generate reports on key performance metrics and provide data-driven insights for decision-making.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Must Haves: Bachelor’s Degree required. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.G., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities)
  • 2-3 years of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred) Some experience with Quality Auditing (QA)
  • Demonstrated expertise in data quality, labeling processes, and maintaining high data integrity. Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to analyze data sets, identify trends and anomalies, and provide insights that drive project improvements.
  • Proven ability to manage tasks independently and contribute effectively to team goals.
  • Strong communication skills for articulating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Parceiro De Negócios

Parceiro(a) de Negócios | AgroBusca®Sobre a oportunidade

No agro, a gente sabe que bons negócios começam com uma boa conversa, confiança e vontade de construir junto.

A AgroBusca está recebendo solicitações de clientes de várias regiões do Brasil e está formando um time de parceiros apaixonados pelo agronegócio, por tecnologia e por ajudar pessoas. Procuramos alguém com iniciativa, boa comunicação e vontade de representar a AgroBusca na sua cidade ou região.

Não buscamos apenas alguém para vender. Buscamos um parceiro capaz de ouvir, entender a realidade de cada cliente e construir relacionamentos duradouros.

O que você fará

Como Parceiro(a) de Negócios AgroBusca, você atuará no desenvolvimento de novos negócios e no relacionamento com clientes e parceiros do setor agro. Acompanhará as oportunidades desde o primeiro contato até a conclusão da negociação, sempre buscando entender as necessidades do mercado e oferecer soluções adequadas ao portfólio da empresa.

No dia a dia, suas principais atividades serão:

  • Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes e parceiros no setor agro.
  • Identificar demandas e oportunidades na sua cidade ou região.
  • Apresentar as soluções da AgroBusca de forma consultiva e clara.
  • Participar de negociações e acompanhar cada oportunidade até a conclusão.
  • Cultivar relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros.
  • Acompanhar os resultados comerciais e contribuir para a satisfação dos envolvidos.
  • Mapear regiões, culturas e segmentos prioritários.
  • Apoiar ações comerciais, relacionamento e marketing.
  • Compartilhar percepções do mercado e sugestões para aprimorar produtos e serviços.
O que esperamos de você

Estamos procurando uma pessoa comunicativa, responsável e com espírito de parceria. Alguém que goste de conversar, tenha facilidade para criar vínculos e entenda que, no agro, cada região tem sua realidade e merece ser tratada com atenção.

É importante ter:

  • Experiência com vendas, desenvolvimento de negócios, representação comercial ou parcerias.
  • Vivência no agronegócio ou em segmentos relacionados. Conhecer produtores, cooperativas, revendas, empresas de insumos ou outros participantes da cadeia será um diferencial.
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e habilidade para apresentar propostas de valor.
  • Perfil consultivo, com capacidade de ouvir, compreender necessidades e propor soluções.
  • Organização, autonomia e disciplina para trabalhar de forma remota.
  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais, como videoconferência, CRM, planilhas e aplicativos de comunicação.
  • Conhecimento básico ou intermediário sobre o mercado agro, suas culturas, canais de distribuição e dinâmica comercial.
Formação e disponibilidade

Formação em Administração, Agronegócios, Gestão Comercial, Marketing ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial, mas valorizamos principalmente a experiência prática, o conhecimento regional e a capacidade de construir bons relacionamentos.

Também é desejável ter disponibilidade para eventuais viagens, reuniões presenciais com clientes e participação em eventos do setor.

Modelo de atuação
  • Atuação remota.
  • Regime de contrato/parceria.
  • Oportunidade de atuação exclusiva por cidade ou região, conforme disponibilidade.
  • Necessidade de organização, autonomia e uso eficiente de ferramentas digitais.
  • Participação em um programa de remuneração competitivo, alinhado ao desenvolvimento dos negócios.
Por que fazer parte da AgroBusca?

Porque aqui você não será apenas mais um contato em uma lista. Queremos construir uma rede de parceiros que conheça sua região, entenda as pessoas e ajude a AgroBusca a chegar cada vez mais longe.

Se você gosta do agro, acredita no poder da tecnologia e tem vontade de crescer construindo junto, talvez essa oportunidade seja para você.

Envie sua apresentação pelo LinkedIn e informe a cidade ou região onde gostaria de atuar.

No agro, ninguém constrói nada sozinho. É com confiança, trabalho e parceria que a gente vai mais longe.

title: Ux Designer
description:
UX Designer (Physical Products & DTC Experience)

Carepod is a premium home wellness brand focused on creating thoughtfully designed consumer products that improve everyday life.

We’re looking for a UX Designer to help us create intuitive, customer-centered experiences across our physical products and digital customer journey. This role combines product usability, customer research, website UX, and customer experience , helping shape everything from product interactions to online purchasing and onboarding.

You’ll work closely with Product Development, Marketing, Customer Support, and HQ to transform customer insights into better products and better experiences.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys owning projects, collaborating across teams, and making a measurable impact on how customers experience our brand.

What You’ll Do

Product UX & Customer Research

  • Conduct product usability testing and customer research
  • Analyze customer reviews, support conversations, surveys, and behavioral insights
  • Identify friction points and recommend customer-focused improvements
  • Build personas, journey maps, and usability documentation

Website UX

  • Improve website and e-commerce user experience
  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and UX recommendations
  • Partner with Marketing to optimize customer education and conversion
  • Improve online product presentation and navigation

Product Experience

  • Improve packaging, onboarding, and instructional materials
  • Collaborate with Product Development on customer-centered product improvements
  • Support user testing for new products and accessories
  • Ensure consistency across physical and digital customer touch points

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Development, Marketing, Customer Support, Operations, and HQ
  • Present research findings and UX recommendations
  • Help coordinate initiatives that improve the overall customer experience

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help us:

  • Deliver more intuitive customer experiences
  • Improve website usability and customer conversion
  • Reduce customer confusion and support contacts
  • Improve packaging and onboarding experiences
  • Turn customer feedback into actionable product improvements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field
  • Experience with direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands
  • Strong UX research and usability testing experience
  • Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and journey maps
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to independently manage multiple projects
  • Strong attention to detail and customer-first mindset

Nice to Have

  • Customer Experience (CX) background
  • Packaging or unboxing design experience
  • Experience with consumer products or home appliances
  • Shopify or Amazon experience
  • Experience improving product onboarding or customer education

Tools

  • Figma
  • Adobe Creative Suite

Who Will Thrive Here

  • Someone who enjoys solving customer problems through thoughtful design
  • Someone who likes balancing research and execution
  • Someone who works well independently while collaborating across teams
  • Someone who enjoys fast-moving environments and high ownership

Who May Not Be a Fit

  • Someone interested only in UI for software products
  • Someone uncomfortable working across multiple business functions
  • Someone who requires highly structured processes and close supervision

title: Analista De Desenvolvimento Analítico Pl
description:
Conheça a Blanver:

A Blanver é uma empresa brasileira com mais de 42 anos de história marcada pela inovação e empreendedorismo. A experiência e atuação no desenvolvimento, fabricação e comercialização de medicamentos e insumos farmacêuticos ativos (IFAs) tornou a Blanver especialista nos segmentos de HIV, Hepatite e Osteoporose, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade, atendendo pacientes no Brasil por meio de parcerias com o Ministério da Saúde e laboratórios oficiais. Além disso, também estamos presentes nos segmentos de Oncologia, Doenças Raras e Hematologia, por meio de parcerias estratégias com grandes parceiros internacionais.

As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a grande diferença na consolidação dos nossos negócios e estamos dedicados a desenvolver equipes em que cada pessoa é reconhecida por sua experiência e suas contribuições exclusivas.

Essas serão algumas das atividades do dia-a-dia como Analista de Desenvolvimento Analitico Pleno.

- Realizar o desenvolvimento e validação de metodologias analíticas, de acordo com as normas exigidas pela RDC 166 e 964 (Anvisa), Elaborar protocolos e relatórios de desenvolvimento analítico e validação de metodologias, visando manter os registros gerados durante as análises.

- Realizar desenvolvimento de metodologias analíticas por LCMS, HPLC, PSD, UV-VIS, DSC e teste físico-químicos.

- Realizar estudos e testes de pré-formulação para atender as solicitações da área de Desenvolvimento Farmacotécnico.

- Prestar suporte técnico aos analistas juniores durante a execução de análises, esclarecimento de dúvidas relacionadas a documentos e relatórios, além de auxiliar na conferência de documentação.

- Realizar análises de risco para embasar alterações em processos industriais, com foco na melhoria contínua e no aumento da eficiência operacional.

- Realizar a adequação pós-registro dos produtos, conforme exigência da Anvisa ou órgãos externos.

- Elaboração, revisão, padronização e controle de documentos técnicos, como métodos analíticos, relatórios de desenvolvimento, validação e transferências analíticas, assegurando a conformidade com as diretrizes regulatórias e os padrões internos de qualidade.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo: Farmácia ou Quimica;
  • Pacote Officee Sesuit;

- Assistência Médica;

title: Analista De Supply Planning Pleno
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

Gerenciar os processos de planejamento de produção de latas e tampas da AMP Brasil do curto prazo, garantindo a otimização de nossos recursos e o capital empregado em nossos estoques, de acordo com os planos aprovados pela Diretoria.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Atualizar os principais indicadores e relatórios da área, tais como: Ocupação de Estoque, Slow Moving , Aderência à Política de Estoque etc.;
  2. Realizar o sequenciamento (scheduling) das linhas de produção de latas e tampas à nível SKU, de acordo com pedidos, política de estoque e/ou acordos comerciais, garantindo que as premissas e restrições operacionais estão sendo seguidas;
  3. Analisar a disponibilidade de produto para atendimento de pedidos e negociar, quando necessário, a flexibilização dos prazos, seja com o time operacional, seja com Customer Service, garantindo a sinergia entre as necessidades da operação com as necessidades de nossos Clientes;
  4. Atualizar os parâmetros de MRP para produtos acabados no SAP semanalmente, conforme variações identificadas;
  5. Atualizar a programação de produção diarizada com base nos alinhamentos realizados com o time de operações para análises de atendimento, ocupação de estoque e consumo de insumos;
  6. Conduzir o ciclo de planejamento de curto prazo (ITP) para latas e tampas à nível produto, com frequência semanal, analisando o cenário de atendimento da demanda, ocupação de estoque, aderência à política de estoque, alocação de estoque, deslocamentos de vendas e otimização de recursos, garantindo a eficiência do processo, bem como preparar o material e conduzir a reunião;
  7. Fornecer projeções de estoque por cliente conforme necessidades dos times financeiro e/ou comercial;
  8. Atuar como ponto focal da equipe de planejamento, garantindo que as operações de curto prazo estejam alinhadas com a estratégia definida para o médio e longo prazo, garantindo uma visão clara do que está acontecendo em todo o processo;

Requisitos:

1) Domínio avançado do Pacote Office

2) SAP IBP

3) Inglês avançado

4) Experiência em planejamento

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

  • Issue, review, and submit to clients invoices related to services, goods, rentals, imports, exports, and telecommunications.
  • Record and approve incoming invoices, verifying tax information and fiscal classifications, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Prepare tax payment slips, such as DARF, DARE, DARJ, and GNRE, among others, in coordination with the central payments team.
  • Validate tax and fiscal information related to REIDI.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and annual accounting closings and directly perform the tax closing process, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of the information.
  • Maintain relationships with government authorities, including the Receita Federal, SEFAZ, City Halls, and other relevant government agencies.

  • Prepare and submit IBGE reports on an annual basis, DICI reports on a monthly basis, and CODEF reports on a semi-annual basis.

  • Organize and maintain reports and records of all invoices issued by the company.
  • Coordinate and follow up on tax-related matters with related parties and internal/external stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience with direct and indirect tax assessment, including ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IRPJ, CSLL, and other applicable taxes.
  • Proficiency in preparing and submitting ancillary tax obligations, including GIA, SPED Fiscal, EFD Contributions, DCTF, and DIRF.
  • Solid knowledge of fiscal classification, including CFOP, NCM, and CST.
  • Experience issuing, reviewing, and recording incoming and outgoing invoices.
  • Experience with tax and fiscal processes related to imports and exports is preferred.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform and its potential impacts on the company’s operations.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Note:

- Position offered shall be determined by the candidate’s years of relevant experience and skillsets.

- All personal data collected will be used for recruitment and employment-related purpose only.

description:

Principais Responsabilidades
