title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
SC — Regional Sales Representative

Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development

Position Details

Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative

Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM

Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM

Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)

Role Overview

The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.G., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.

Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations.
  • Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory.
  • Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards.
  • Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments.
  • Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel.
  • Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities.
  • Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities.
  • Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company.
  • Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information.
  • Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the IoT segment.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.
  • Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, LoRa, satellite communication, and antennas.
  • Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil.
  • Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial IoT, or connected mobility verticals.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.G., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard productivity software.
  • Spanish language skills a plus.

About Quectel

Quectel is a global IoT solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and IoT connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.

With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (IoT platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.

Life at Quectel LATAM

At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.

  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in IoT modules.
  • Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
  • Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams.
  • A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.

Industries & Applications

Quectel's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:

  • Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions.
  • Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility.
  • Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking.
  • Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring.
  • Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring.
  • Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility.
  • Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security.

Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications.
  • Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.
  • Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure.
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).

Explore Quectel — Links & Resources

We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.

Company & Careers

Company Website: — Global IoT solutions provider

Quectel Careers: quectel.Com/about-quectel/career — Open roles across the Quectel ecosystem

Quectel News & Press: quectel.Com/news-and-pr — Latest company announcements

Follow Us on Social Media

LinkedIn: Quectel Wireless Solutions — Company updates, job posts, industry news

YouTube: Quectel on YouTube — Product demos, tech talks, and event highlights

Technical & Developer Resources

Quectel Developer Zone: developer.Quectel.Com — Docs, SDKs, tools, and developer support

Product Selector: quectel.Com/product-selector — Browse the full portfolio of IoT modules and antennas

Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)
description:
Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)

Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract

Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)

Reports To: CRO / Founder

Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)

We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities.

  • In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations:

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.G., QuickBooks Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize).
  • Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations.
  • Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office).

2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR):

  • Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners.
  • Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices ( Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e ) where applicable.
  • Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese.

3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements:

  • Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors.
  • Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports.
  • Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure).

4. Data Integrity & Reporting:

  • Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity.
  • Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices.
  • Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies).
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (QuickBooks, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets.
  • Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais , basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote working environment with flexibility.
  • Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

title: Arquitetura De Soluções Azure - 134713
description:

Responsabilidades:

  • Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).
  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.

title: Process And Automation Consultant (3 Months)
description:
We are seeking a Process and Automation Consultant – RPA Specialist to join a three‑month advisory engagement that supports the migration of the core pricing system. The consultant will own the end‑to‑end documentation of current pricing and agreement processes, uncover manual pain points, and design automation‑ready future‑state workflows. The role reports to the engagement lead and works closely with operational teams, the client’s internal stakeholders, and external implementation vendors.

Key Responsibilities

Document current‑state end‑to‑end pricing and agreement processes, including handoffs, exception paths, and workarounds. Quantify manual effort, cycle times, rework, and error rates using available data sources. Conduct structured process‑discovery workshops with operational teams to surface bottlenecks and improvement ideas. Identify and evaluate automation opportunities (RPA, workflow orchestration, rules‑based validation) and assess their long‑term viability. Design future‑state workflow alternatives that support agreement intake, validation, approval, and publication. Prioritize automation and redesign initiatives with effort, impact, and risk estimates. Distinguish automation that resolves root causes from automation that merely masks underlying process defects. Produce validated documentation and present findings to senior stakeholders for decision‑making.

✅ Job Requirements

Minimum 6 years of experience in business process analysis, process improvement, or intelligent‑automation consulting. Advanced English proficiency (C1 level) with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to create process maps using BPMN, value‑stream mapping, SIPOC, or comparable

techniques. Hands‑on experience delivering RPA solutions with platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate, or similar. Demonstrated capability to lead and facilitate structured workshops with cross‑functional operational teams. Strong analytical skills to quantify manual effort, cycle times, and error rates.

Preferred Skills

Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. Direct experience in pricing, rebates, or order‑to‑cash operations. Exposure to process‑mining tools such as Celonis or comparable solutions. Familiarity with workflow‑orchestration platforms (e.G., Camunda, Microsoft Power Automate).

title: Head Of Risk, Brazil
description:
Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to

lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the

primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring

our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.

About the Role

As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk

management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and

other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties

  • Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.

Operational cum Technology Risk Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management.
  • Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management
  • Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience.
  • Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security
  • frameworks.
  • Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments.
  • Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers.
  • Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.

Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)

Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).
  • Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.
  • Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.
  • Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).
  • Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).
  • Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.
  • Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies.
  • Professional certifications in risk management (e.G., FRM, CRM) a plus.
  • Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.

P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Atividades

Interpretar relatórios de saúde da plataforma e aconselhar sobre planos de remediação relacionados à manutenibilidade, desempenho, segurança e capacidade de atualização.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Identificar, monitorar e avaliar proativamente riscos nas dimensões arquitetural, técnica e de saúde da plataforma. Orientar os clientes sobre estratégias de mitigação para garantir que os riscos sejam tratados antes de se tornarem incidentes.

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.

  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

Os elementos de terras raras (ETRs) de alto valor que a Serra Verde fornece, são essenciais para a produção de ímãs permanentes usados nos setores de energia, transporte, aeroespacial e eletrônico.

Iniciamos a produção comercial na Fase I do nosso depósito Pela Ema, abrigando um dos maiores depósitos de argila iônica fora da Ásia, com vantagens competitivas e ambientais devido à natureza do depósito, com impactos ambientais relativamente baixos e situado em uma área de mineração consolidada, próxima à infraestrutura de energia renovável.

Na Serra Verde, nossos valores nos guiam todos os dias: Atuamos com integridade, confiança e transparência. Valorizamos a excelência. Criamos e compartilhamos valor sustentável. Somos otimistas e apaixonados. Assumimos a responsabilidade pessoal. Somos corajosos e empreendedores.

As inscrições também estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCDs), mulheres e grupos prioritários, em conformidade com os princípios de inclusão e equidade.

Como você poderá contribuir?

Irá coordenar as atividades de manutenção preventiva, diagnósticos de falhas e serviços de reparação mecânica em máquinas e equipamentos, analisando viabilidade de trocas ou recuperação de peças danificadas, acompanhando o processo com catálogos e manuais de serviços, a fim de executar as atividades de acordo com especificações do fabricante, visando mantê-las em perfeitas condições de funcionamento.

title: Regional Sales Manager, Brazil (Chinese Speaking)
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a country manager with entrepreneurial spirit and strong results orientation, responsible for building and leading the company's business in the LATAM region from scratch. This is a unique high-impact position suitable for sales leaders who crave challenges and autonomy. You will be responsible for developing market entry strategies, establishing key partnerships, building high-performance sales teams, and driving significant revenue growth. Your success will be directly rewarded through an unlimited commission structure.

Main responsibilities

  • Partnership Development : Proactively identify, approach, and build strong relationships with strategic partners, affiliates, communities, and key opinion leaders (KOLs). Maintain high outreach velocity and continuously expand a quality partner network.
  • Business Growth & KPI Achievement : Drive regional performance by improving key commercial metrics related to customer acquisition, engagement, and overall revenue contribution. Deliver measurable business impact through disciplined execution and performance tracking.
  • Full BD Process Ownership : Independently manage the entire BD lifecycle - prospecting, qualification, negotiation, follow-ups, closing, and post-deal maintenance. Ensure fast execution and a healthy pipeline.
  • Client & Partner Relationship Management : Build and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with partners. Increase engagement, retention, and contribution through proactive and high-frequency communication.
  • Market Research & Competitive Insights : Monitor regulatory updates, competitor strategies, user behaviour, and market dynamics in the LATAM region. Provide actionable insights and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Localized Marketing Collaboration : Work closely with marketing teams to support localized content, community engagement, and event initiatives. Ensure smooth and effective execution across Portuguese-speaking markets.Re all sales and partnership activities comply with local regulations and company policies.

Job requirements (must be met)

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in sales or business development, capable of independently acquiring and converting clients.
  • Strong execution, self-discipline, and ability to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain long-term relationships and manage high-frequency partner interactions.
  • Good command of English and Portuguese for business communication (Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus).
  • High resilience and emotional stability under pressure and rejection.
  • Existing partner, affiliate, community, or KOL resources that can contribute value in the short term.
  • Experience in digital platforms, online services, fintech, or other performance-driven industries, or strong personal familiarity with similar ecosystems.
  • Strong hunter mindset: bonus-driven, results-oriented, and motivated by performance-based outcomes.

We provide

  • Uncapped Income Potential: An attractive compensation package that includes a generous base salary and more importantly an uncapped commission structure that directly rewards your performance.
  • Autonomy and Influence: Freedom to form your own team and develop strategies for the entire region. Your decisions will directly affect the global success of the company.
  • Career Development: This is a senior leadership position where you will have great career and financial advancement opportunities as the company grows.
  • Global Environment: Work with a diverse international team to serve customers worldwide.
  • Remote work flexibility: can work from anywhere in the world.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

We are seeking a talented Video Editor to create high-performing video content for paid social advertising campaigns. You will edit engaging, conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Instagram Reels while working closely with our creative strategists and design team. This role requires fast turnaround capabilities, a keen understanding of performance creative principles, and the ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously in a fully remote environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently high video output with exceptional quality and attention to detail
  • Strong creative performance metrics (CTR, watch time, engagement) across your video portfolio
  • Seamless collaboration with creative strategists, designers, and media buyers to iterate and optimize
  • Efficient project management and timely delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts

Responsibilities

  • Edit high-performing video ads for paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Execute on creative briefs and storyboards developed by creative strategists
  • Add motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and effects to enhance video storytelling and performance
  • Work with raw UGC footage and branded content to create attention-grabbing, under-15-second video ads
  • Iterate quickly on video concepts based on performance data and feedback from media buyers
  • Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts while adapting to different brand voices
  • Organize and manage video assets, project files, and creative libraries across all client accounts
  • Stay current on platform trends, best practices, and format specifications for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta
  • Collaborate with creative strategists on video concepts and provide input on creative direction
  • Conduct research on competitor ads and trending content to inform video creative approaches
  • Pull and optimize stills from videos for ad thumbnails and static creative variations
  • Participate in weekly design team meetings and collaborate with designers and fellow video editors

Requirements

  • 2-4 years of video editing experience, preferably in performance marketing or advertising
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
  • Motion graphics and animation capabilities
  • Portfolio demonstrating social-first video work for paid advertising (Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels)
  • Strong understanding of performance creative principles and direct response video best practices
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and high volume output
  • Experience editing UGC (User Generated Content) and creator-style content
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong quality control standards
  • Fluent English communication skills for client collaboration and team coordination
  • DTC or ecommerce experience working with product-focused brands
  • Comfortable working remotely with distributed teams across multiple time zones

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CapCut or other mobile-first editing tools
  • Sound design and audio mixing skills
  • Understanding of TikTok and Instagram Reels trends and viral content strategies
  • Experience with color grading and advanced post-production techniques
  • Basic design skills in Figma or Adobe Creative Suite
  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client projects

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Engenheiro Geotécnico
description:
A Tractebel é uma multinacional referência global em engenharia consultiva com mais de 160 anos de história, e faz parte do Grupo ENGIE , líder mundial em transição energética. Além de fornecermos soluções integradas nas áreas de infraestrutura, energia, meio ambiente e recursos hídricos, atuamos também na administração e no gerenciamento de obras desses setores, contribuindo para a missão do Grupo de tornar o mundo mais resiliente, habitável, energizado e sustentável.

Aqui, você participa de projetos de grande impacto , aprende com especialistas renomados e desenvolve sua carreira em um ambiente colaborativo e multidisciplinar, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da qualidade de vida de milhões de pessoas .

Cada projeto é uma oportunidade de deixar um legado de engenharia do qual nos orgulhamos — e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte dessa transformação como Engenheiro Geotécnico.

ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO:

  • Acompanhamento Geotécnico em Campo: Acompanhar tecnicamente as frentes de fundações de torres de linhas de transmissão, verificando as condições reais do terreno, escavações, estabilidade de taludes, presença de água, blocos rochosos, solos moles, materiais colapsíveis ou expansivos e demais condicionantes geológico-geotécnicos relevantes.
  • Análise e Validação de Fundações: Avaliar a compatibilidade entre o projeto de fundação e as condições encontradas em campo, apoiando a validação de soluções como tubulões, sapatas, blocos, estacas, fundações em rocha ou soluções especiais, conforme critérios técnicos, executivos e de segurança.
  • Investigações Geotécnicas e Geológicas: Acompanhar, interpretar e validar informações oriundas de sondagens, ensaios de campo, inspeções visuais, mapeamentos geológico-geotécnicos, caracterização de solos e rochas, bem como demais dados necessários ao adequado entendimento das condições de fundação.
  • Acessos e Condições de Trafegabilidade: Avaliar tecnicamente os acessos às torres, incluindo condições de solo, declividade, drenagem, estabilidade de cortes e aterros, capacidade de suporte, riscos de erosão, travessias, interferências e necessidade de melhorias para viabilizar o transporte de equipamentos, materiais e equipes.
  • Identificação de Riscos e Recomendações Técnicas: Identificar desvios, anomalias, riscos geotécnicos, instabilidades, recalques potenciais, surgência de água, erosões e demais condições que possam impactar a execução ou o desempenho das fundações e acessos, emitindo recomendações técnicas e acompanhando sua implementação.
  • Controle de Qualidade e Conformidade Técnica: Verificar a aderência da execução aos projetos, especificações técnicas, procedimentos construtivos, critérios de aceitação, normas aplicáveis e boas práticas de engenharia, apoiando a liberação técnica de fundações e acessos.
  • Relatórios, Registros e Interface Técnica: Elaborar pareceres, relatórios técnicos, registros fotográficos, checklists, croquis de campo e recomendações geotécnicas, mantendo interface com engenharia, fiscalização, construtoras, equipes de topografia, planejamento, qualidade, SMS, meio ambiente e cliente.

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only. About SigmaMD

SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.

About this role

We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.

Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.

This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.

And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.

You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.

What you'll do

Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.

Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.

Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.

Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.

Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.
What we're looking for

1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.

2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to "who decides this?" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.

3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.

4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.

Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain;
a portfolio of complex,information-dense product work (not marketing pages);
expert Figma;
and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.

Who you might be

You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.

Nice to have
  • Revenue cycle management or insurance billing — claims, eligibility, remittance, denials, prior authorization, clearinghouse integrations. This is where we're heading, and the hardest thing on this list to teach.
  • Payments, billing, subscriptions, or fintech (merchant processing, ACH, PCI, benefits eligibility feeds).
  • Healthcare, digital health, or EHR experience
  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS, design tokens) and design-system authorship.
  • Comfort with AI-assisted workflows for research, spec writing, and analysis.
Our values

Teamwork, empathy, and innovation — and caring that on the other end of every decision is a physician trying to run an independent practice and their patients.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You’ll Do
  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack , Zoom , and Google Workspace .
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.
What We’re Looking For
  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses
Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.
The Aerial Core Way
  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Head De Operações
description:
Missão

Liderar e desenvolver a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito de operações financeiras agrícolas, assegurando excelência na execução, segurança jurídica, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade e geração de resultados.

Será responsável por estruturar uma operação altamente padronizada, auditável e orientada por dados, capaz de conduzir toda a jornada de recuperação de crédito — desde a cobrança preventiva e extrajudicial até a preparação dos casos para judicialização — preservando a exigibilidade dos créditos, a qualidade das evidências e a efetividade das estratégias adotadas.

Atuará como principal elo entre Operações, Jurídico, Produto, Engenharia e áreas de negócio, transformando desafios operacionais em processos, controles, automações e soluções tecnológicas. Buscamos uma liderança com forte capacidade de execução, profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e habilidade para construir uma operação escalável por meio de dados, tecnologia, inteligência artificial e melhoria contínua.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a operação de cobrança e recuperação de crédito, garantindo produtividade, qualidade, segurança jurídica e cumprimento dos prazos;
  • Definir a estratégia operacional das carteiras, considerando exposição financeira, estágio da inadimplência, perfil do devedor, garantias disponíveis e expectativa de recuperação;
  • Governar todaa jornada de recuperação, incluindo notificações, negociações, promessas de pagamento, acordos, protestos, negativação, baixas, gestão de garantias e preparação para judicialização;
  • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar políticas, fluxos, procedimentos, critérios de priorização, níveis de alçada e controles internos;
  • Assegurar a rastreabilidade das ações de cobrança e a adequada formalização de contatos, propostas, acordos, pagamentos, garantias e demais evidências;
  • Garantir, em parceria com o Jurídico, que os casos encaminhados à judicialização estejam completos, fundamentados e documentalmente preparados, preservando a exigibilidade do crédito;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e dimensionar a equipe de acordo com o volume, a complexidade e as prioridades das carteiras, atuando também como referência técnica em casos críticos;
  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de recuperação, produtividade, aging, acordos, promessas de pagamento, SLAs, custos e qualidade operacional;
  • Conduzir comitês de cobrança e elaborar análises executivas sobre resultados, riscos, estratégias adotadas e oportunidades de recuperação;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e ganho de escala, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em requisitos para Produto, Engenharia e fornecedores de tecnologia;
  • Aplicar dadose inteligência artificial na segmentação de carteiras, priorização de casos, recomendação de estratégias e controle da qualidade operacional;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, fundos, cedentes, escritórios jurídicos e parceiros especializados, assegurando alinhamento sobre estratégias, prazos e resultados.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência consolidada em liderança de operações de cobrança extrajudicial e recuperação de crédito;
  • Vivência na gestão de carteiras inadimplentes de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos fluxos de cobrança, negociação, protesto, negativação, acordos, garantias e preparação para judicialização;
  • Experiência na estruturação, revisão e melhoria de processos operacionais;
  • Histórico de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes de alta performance;
  • Experiência com indicadores, metas, SLAs e gestão orientada por dados;
  • Capacidade deanálise de carteiras, definição de prioridades e construção de estratégias de recuperação;
  • Experiência em projetos de automação, implantação de sistemas ou transformação digital;
  • Boa interlocução com áreas Jurídica, Financeira, Produto e Engenharia;
  • Capacidade deatuar de forma estratégica e, simultaneamente, acompanhar a execução operacional em profundidade.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência em operações de crédito, cobrança ou recuperação de ativos no agronegócio;
  • Vivência em fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs, instituições financeiras, empresas de insumos ou gestoras de crédito;
  • Conhecimento sobre operações estruturadas, direitos creditórios, cessão de crédito e garantias agrícolas;
  • Familiaridadecom CPRs, duplicatas, penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão fiduciária, garantias reais e pessoais;
  • Experiência na gestão de escritórios jurídicos, consultorias e fornecedores especializados;
  • Conhecimento em inteligência artificial, automação e análise de dados aplicadas à cobrança;
  • Vivência com LegalOps, sistemas de cobrança, CRMs ou plataformas de gestão de carteiras;
  • Pós-graduaçãoem Finanças, Gestão, Agronegócio, Direito Empresarial ou áreas correlatas.

Competências Esperadas

  • Liderança com forte orientação para execução;
  • Visão estratégica e pensamento sistêmico;
  • Capacidade detomar decisões em ambientes de pressão e incerteza;
  • Profundidade analítica e domínio de indicadores;
  • Excelente capacidade de negociação;
  • Comunicação clara, firme e executiva;
  • Disciplina deprocessos e atenção à qualidade;
  • Senso de urgência e capacidade de priorização;
  • Protagonismo,autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Capacidade deconstruir soluções em ambientes em desenvolvimento;
  • Facilidade para transitar entre negócio, jurídico, operação e tecnologia;
  • Orientação para resultado sem comprometer governança e segurança jurídica.

Principais Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Aumento da taxa e do valor de recuperação das carteiras;
  • Redução do tempo médio de tratamento e recuperação;
  • Aumento da conversão de acordos e promessas de pagamento;
  • Cumprimento dos SLAs operacionais;
  • Redução de falhas documentais e operacionais;
  • Qualidade e completude dos casos encaminhados à judicialização;
  • Evolução da produtividade e da capacidade operacional;
  • Maior previsibilidade sobre resultados, riscos e expectativa de recuperação;
  • Implantação de automações e ganhos mensuráveis de eficiência;
  • Satisfação dos clientes e stakeholders com a gestão das carteiras.

O que temos por aqui:

title: Sales Ninja Wanted: Turn Refund Requests Into Retained Revenue
description:
Do Not Apply If You Do Not Speak Professional Level of English

We are a fast-growing travel facilitation company processing thousands of applications per month across multiple destinations including the United Kingdom, Thailand and Aruba. We are looking for a sharp, persuasive Customer Support Specialist to join our team and take ownership of refund disputes, chargeback defence and escalated customer communications. This is a role for someone who knows how to read people, handle objections, and turn a customer who wants their money back into one who feels understood and stays with us.

What you will be doing

  • Handling inbound refund and cancellation requests across email, and looking for the angle that resolves them in the company's favour without leaving the customer feeling unheard
  • Drafting professional, firm and legally informed responses to customer disputes
  • Managing chargeback defence submissions with supporting evidence packages
  • Liaising with payment processors on disputed transactions
  • Maintaining accurate case notes and escalating where necessary
  • Working closely with our Senior Paralegal team on complex cases

What we are looking for

  • Background in appointment setting, sales, or a closing-focused role, you know how to handle objections and guide a conversation to an outcome
  • A genuine interest in human psychology and what actually moves someone from "no" to "yes"
  • Excellent written English with strong attention to tone and detail
  • Comfortable negotiating outcomes rather than just reciting policy
  • Ability to stay calm, professional and firm under pressure
  • Familiarity with consumer protection frameworks is a strong advantage
  • Experience working with payment processors such as Stripe, Wise or similar
  • Ability to work independently and manage a high volume of cases
  • Previous experience in travel, legal support, e-commerce, or high-ticket sales is preferred
  • Love for performance

What we offer

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Fast-paced and dynamic environment with real ownership of your role
  • Direct collaboration with senior leadership

If you know how to read a room, handle an objection, and turn a tense conversation into a win for both sides, we want to hear from you.

Apply by sending your CV and a short cover letter explaining a time you talked someone into, or out of, something. Put "pink flamingo" in the subject so I know you read this far.

title: Virtual Assistant

title: Sales Manager

Modelo de cooperação flexível, baseado no desempenho e na contribuição para os negócios.

Flexible cooperation based on performance and business contribution. Relevant details will be confirmed before cooperation or project work begins.

title: Representante Técnico(A) De Vendas - Linha Aminoagro/Dimicron
description:
Faça parte da ICL:

Na ICL, acreditamos que a inovação começa com pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Somos uma empresa global de soluções em especialidades, com presença em mais de 30 países e impacto em setores essenciais como agricultura, alimentos e materiais industriais.

Como líder mundial na fabricação de fertilizantes de eficiência aprimorada, oferecemos aos agricultores e à indústria soluções avançadas para uma agricultura de alto desempenho, incluindo produtos especiais de alta qualidade para diferentes necessidades. Nosso trabalho contribui para aumentar a produtividade, a rentabilidade e a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

No Brasil, nossa trajetória é marcada por crescimento sustentável, compromisso com a inovação e respeito às comunidades onde atuamos. Com unidades em diversas regiões do país, temos orgulho de impulsionar o desenvolvimento da agricultura brasileira, promovendo práticas mais eficientes e sustentáveis.

Nossa missão:

Gerar impacto positivo no mundo dos alimentos, agricultura e produtos industriais, avançando para um futuro sustentável para toda a humanidade.

Como fazemos isso:

Unimos nossos recursos naturais, a dedicação de uma equipe talentosa e nossa capacidade tecnológica para ampliar a produção de alimentos, garantir sua qualidade, viabilizar uma agricultura e uma produção industrial sustentáveis e proteger o meio ambiente.

Nossos princípios:

  • Inovação: Criada por pessoas apaixonadas, apoiada por infraestrutura de P&D e parcerias estratégicas, formando um ecossistema único.
  • Cuidado: Fazer o que é certo para nossos colaboradores, parceiros de negócios, acionistas, comunidades e meio ambiente.
  • Liderança: Atuar como referência em inovação, gestão de custos e sustentabilidade, com mentalidade orientada a resultados e espírito vencedor.

Vaga: RTV

Região: Querência

Modalidade : PJ

Atividades:

  • Prospecção de clientes finais e distribuidores;
  • Realização devendas e desenvolvimento a campo do portfólio da empresa;
  • Treinamento de canais de venda e assistência técnica, garantindo o suporte necessário para o crescimento dos negócios.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Agronomia;
  • Conhecimento em nutrição de plantas e fertilidade de solo (desejável);
  • Familiaridadecom a região de atuação, proporcionando um atendimento eficaz e personalizado aos clientes.

Na ICL, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para as pessoas independentemente de raça, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica. Embora esta posição não seja afirmativa/exclusiva, reforçamos que todas as pessoas são bem-vindas a se candidatar. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências e ficaremos felizes em receber sua candidatura!

title: Sales Engineer(Brazil)
description:
Company Overview

Renepoly (Official Website: ) is a provider of smart microgrid and energy storage solutions in the new energy industry. Our products cover commercial & industrial energy storage and utility-scale energy storage systems, coupled with a self-developed Energy Management System (EMS). We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.

Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.

Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

5. Proactively identify potential clients and expand market share in the new energy storage sector.

Requirements:

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with 5+ years of sales experience in new energy, electrical, EPC, PV, or energy storage.

2. Background in new energy vehicles, equipment, or engineering industries.

3. Fluency in English.

4. Ability to independently develop clients and execute sales tasks with a proactive approach.

6. Experience in warehouse or inventory management is a plus.

7. Update the progress of customer follow-up weekly.

8. Hold regular business progress reporting meetings with the Director of Foreign Trade and the General Manager of Brazil every two weeks.

Note: The position requires signing a cooperation contract with RENEPOLY’s Hong Kong branch.

Join us and share the green-economy opportunity!

title: Engenheiro / Especialista De Manutenção (Sorter / Logística) - Santa Maria Df
description:
Engenheiro / Especialista de Manutenção (Sorter Center / Logística de E-commerce)

Sobre a vaga: Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) ou Especialista em Manutenção de Sorters para atuar na gestão técnica, confiabilidade e melhoria contínua dos sistemas automatizados de classificação e movimentação de encomendas (Sorter Centers), garantindo alta disponibilidade operacional e máxima eficiência dos equipamentos em uma operação logística de grande porte.

Buscamos um profissional com forte conhecimento em manutenção eletromecânica, automação industrial e gestão de manutenção, capaz de atuar tanto na estratégia quanto na execução técnica, apoiando a expansão da malha logística da companhia em todo o Brasil.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como referência técnica na manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva dos sistemas de Sorters e transportadores automatizados;
  • Desenvolver eimplementar planos de manutenção utilizando conceitos de PCM (Planejamento e Controle da Manutenção);
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho da manutenção, como:
  • MTTR (Mean Time to Repair);
  • MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures);
  • Disponibilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Confiabilidade;
  • Backlog de manutenção;
  • Cumprimento do plano preventivo;
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas, elétricas, eletrônicas e de automação, garantindo rápida recuperação da operação;
  • Executar e acompanhar intervenções em motores elétricos, inversores de frequência, redutores, sensores, esteiras transportadoras, correias, rolamentos, CLPs, sistemas de controle e redes industriais;
  • Liderar análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementar ações para eliminação de falhas recorrentes;
  • Elaborar procedimentos técnicos, planos de inspeção e documentação de manutenção;
  • Atuar em projetos de melhoria contínua, modernização e expansão dos Sorter Centers;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas de segurança, qualidade e disponibilidade operacional;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Operações, Engenharia, Facilities e fornecedores especializados;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecatrônica, Engenharia de Automação, Engenharia de Controle ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em manutenção de sistemas automatizados de classificação (Sorters);
  • Vivência em operações logísticas de alta volumetria ou centros de distribuição automatizados;
  • Conhecimento em PCM (Planejamento e Controle da Manutenção);
  • Experiência prática com:
  • Inversores de frequência;
  • Motores elétricos;
  • Redutores;
  • Correias transportadoras;
  • Rolamentos;
  • Sensores CLPs;
  • Sistemas de controle;
  • Redes industriais;
  • Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos e mecânicos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes em território nacional;

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em empresas de logística, e-commerce, courier ou centros de distribuição automatizados;
  • Vivência com equipamentos de fabricantes como Interroll, Dematic, Honeywell Intelligrated, Vanderlande, Siemens, BEUMER, Fives, Okura, Damon, Equinox ou similares;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias Lean, TPM, RCM e WCM;
  • Experiência com CMMS/EAM (SAP PM, Maximo, Totvs, Fracttal ou similares;
  • Inglês técnico e/ou Mandarim serão considerados diferenciais;

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Perfil técnico e hands-on;
  • Forte capacidade analitica;
  • Proatividade e senso de urgência;
  • Organização eplanejamento;
  • Facilidade para resolução de problemas complexos;

  • Foco em segurança, qualidade e resultados;

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Case Assembly Drafter (Humanitarian Immigration)
description:
Who Are We?

Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.

We specialize in:

  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

Your Role as a

The Case Assembly Drafter plays a pivotal role in preparing, organizing, and finalizing all components of a client’s immigration case prior to attorney review. This position ensures every filing is complete, accurate, and supported by required evidence. Ideal candidates bring exceptional attention to detail, strong writing skills, and the ability to manage multiple case components in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

Drafting & Documentation

  • Draft cover letters for all immigration case types.
  • Prepare TVAP referral emails and attorney affidavits for T‑Visa filings.
  • Draft 918B cover letters for U‑Visa certifications.
  • Summarize FBI background reports for T‑Visa cases.
  • Draft country conditions reports and SIJS‑specific filings.

Case Assembly

  • Assemble complete case filings in PDF format following firm standards.
  • Ensure all forms, declarations, evidence, and supporting documents are included and properly organized.
  • Upload supporting documents and applications for online‑filed cases.
  • Submit finalized case packets for attorney review using Airtable workflows.

Client & Evidence Management

  • Collect client signatures on all forms and declarations.
  • Gather and upload psychological evaluations.
  • For SIJS cases, collect signatures on GC‑211s.
  • Verify completeness and consistency of all required evidence.

Quality Control & Accuracy Checks

  • Conduct credibility checks to ensure dates, timelines, and narratives align across all documents.
  • Confirm all mandatory documents are present before submitting cases for review.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Submit formal requests to hold cases in abeyance when appropriate.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to obtain missing documents or follow‑up information.

Required Competencies & Skills

  • Bilingual or professional fluency in English.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies in client narratives and timelines.
  • Strong writing skills for drafting affidavits, cover letters, and formal requests.
  • Solid understanding of immigration case components and evidence requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and time‑management abilities.
  • Skilled in tracking signatures, evaluations, and supporting documentation.
  • Strong communication skills for client coordination and internal collaboration.
  • Comfort using Airtable, PDF tools, and online filing systems.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Comprehensive training.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Garantir a execução, controle e conformidade dos processos operacionais e regulatórios do mercado de energia, assegurando a qualidade das informações, o cumprimento de prazos e das obrigações junto aos geradores, distribuidora e fornecedores.

  • Apurar, validar e liberar dados de medição para faturamento geração distribuída compartilhada;
  • Operacionalizar registros, validações e ajustes de rateios nas distribuidoras;
  • Acompanhar asobrigações financeiras dos geradores parceiros;
  • Realização conciliação de faturamento e registro energético;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, de faturamento e suporte às áreas de auditoria e financeiro;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de inconsistências operacionais, propondo melhorias nos processos;
  • Manter comunicação clara e eficaz com clientes, áreas internas, órgãos reguladores e demais partes interessadas;
  • Organizar e gerenciar demandas simultâneas, assegurando a qualidade das entregas e o cumprimento dos prazos.
