title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Promo Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.

Role Overview

As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.

The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.

You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.

Key Responsibilities

1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing

  • Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.
  • Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance.
  • Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.
  • Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.
  • Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.

2. Adaptation & Localization

  • Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience.
  • Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.
  • Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.

3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement

  • Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.
  • Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.
  • Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.
  • Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.

4. Production-Ready Script Delivery

  • Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.
  • Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.
  • Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.
  • Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.

5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses

  • Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.
  • Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.
  • Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.

6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration

  • Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.
  • Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.
  • Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.
  • Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.

7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization

  • Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.
  • Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.
  • Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.
  • Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.
  • Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.
  • Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.
  • Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams.
  • Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.

They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Vendedora (E-Commerce)
description:
VAGA: Vendedora – Dalla Store

Presencial — São Caetano do Sul

Remuneração: Fixo + comissão sobre vendas

Horário sugerido: Segunda a Sexta, das 9:00 às 18:00 horas

Vaga Efetiva (com experiência de 3 meses)

SOBRE A DALLA STORE

A Dalla não contrata pra preencher cadeira.

Somos um e-commerce de moda feminina em crescimento acelerado, com o propósito de facilitar a rotina das mulheres através de conjuntos práticos, confortáveis e estilosos. Estamos construindo a maior marca brasileira de conjuntos femininos até 2035 — e o time precisa crescer nesse ritmo.

Essa vaga não é de "responder mensagem no automático e esperar a venda acontecer". É de assumir o relacionamento com a cliente do primeiro contato até a compra — e fazer ela voltar.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Você vai garantir que cada conversa com a cliente seja conduzida com clareza, agilidade e poder de conversão — do primeiro "oi" até o fechamento.

O jogo é claro: se a cliente compra, recomenda e volta a comprar... você venceu. E vai ser recompensada por isso.

  • Atender e conduzir vendas via Instagram e WhatsApp, do primeiro contato ao fechamento
  • Identificar a necessidade da cliente e indicar o produto certo — sem empurrar peça errada só pra bater meta
  • Fazer follow-up ativo de carrinhos abandonados e clientes em negociação, sem deixar lead esfriar
  • Identificar objeções recorrentes e ajustar a abordagem antes que virem perda de venda
  • Bater metas diárias e semanais de conversão e ticket médio
  • Garantir que a cliente saia satisfeita e pronta para comprar de novo

O Que Esperamos de Você

  • Comunicação escrita ágil, persuasiva e sem erro de português — você escreve rápido e bem o dia inteiro
  • Resiliência de verdade — muita conversa não vira venda, e isso não pode te abalar nem mudar seu padrão de atendimento
  • Organização para conduzir várias conversas em paralelo sem perder o timing de cada uma
  • Leitura de cenário e senso de dono — perceber quando uma cliente está quase fechando e agir, sem esperar comando
  • Capacidade de receber feedback e cobrança como parte do jogo — aqui ninguém vai adivinhar o que você sente, vamos te dizer na cara o que precisa melhorar

Diferenciais (Vai Te Destacar Muito)

  • Já vendeu algo — online, loja física ou redes sociais — e tem exemplo concreto de resultado, não só "tenho jeito com pessoas"
  • Experiência em atendimento de alto volume via Instagram/WhatsApp
  • Vivência com moda, e-commerce ou vendas consultivas
  • Familiaridade com métricas básicas de venda (conversão, ticket médio, follow-up)

Não É Pra Você Se:

  • Precisa que expliquem o que dizer em cada nova objeção da cliente
  • Acha que vendas é só "responder o que perguntam" e esperar a cliente decidir sozinha
  • Não lida bem com "não" — e desanima ou perde ritmo depois de uma sequência de recusas
  • Busca ambiente estável, sem meta e sem pressão por resultado
  • Não se sente confortável sendo cobrada por número, todos os dias

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Comissão real sobre performance, sem teto
  • Treinamento sobre produto, abordagem e cultura Dalla
  • Ambiente de ritmo acelerado, com metas claras e feedback constante
  • Possibilidade real de evolução para liderança de vendas conforme a Dalla escala
  • A chance de sentir na pele o impacto direto do seu trabalho no resultado da empresa

title: Buyer
description:
About the Company

Tenneco is one of the world’s leading designers, manufacturers, and marketers of automotive products for original equipment and aftermarket customers, with approximately 65,000 team members working across more than 200 locations worldwide.

Through our four business groups — DRiV, Performance Solutions, Clean Air, and Powertrain — Tenneco is driving advancements in global mobility by delivering technology solutions to diverse markets, including light vehicles, commercial trucks, off-highway, industrial, motorsports, and aftermarket applications.

This position will be part of Tenneco’s Ride Performance business , within the Shock Absorbers division , based in Mogi Mirim, São Paulo, Brazil .

About the Role

The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing and developing productive materials for new product development projects across multiple commodities, including steel, stamped components, sintered parts, tubes, machined components, plastics, bearings, fasteners, rubber, chemicals, and others.

This role will be responsible for obtaining quotations and supporting the development and cost evaluation of new products, working closely with Quality and Engineering teams to develop new suppliers and products according to technical specifications. The position will also be responsible for negotiating commercial conditions and implementing commercial agreements and contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Request and analyze quotations in accordance with company policies from qualified and/or potential suppliers, ensuring compliance with technical specifications, quantities, delivery requirements, and project timelines.
  • Obtain quotations for productive materials to support the preparation and evaluation of the Bill of Materials (BOM) for new products.
  • Negotiate prices, payment terms, delivery conditions, and other commercial requirements with suppliers.
  • Conduct technical and commercial analysis of supplier proposals in collaboration with Quality and Product Engineering teams.
  • Lead the sourcing process and obtain the required internal approvals.
  • Select and nominate suppliers and coordinate the issuance and execution of commercial contracts.
  • Request and follow up on required PPAP documentation .
  • Follow up, when applicable, on quality testing, sample deliveries, and validation activities to ensure that materials and/or finished products meet project specifications and deadlines.
  • Analyze technical and financial proposals for new and existing components to achieve competitive sourcing results.
  • Negotiate competitive payment terms to optimize the company’s working capital.
  • Follow up on the issuance of Purchase Orders and, when applicable, monitor the process through material delivery to ensure internal stakeholders’ requirements are met.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams throughout the new product development and sourcing process.
  • Support cost competitiveness and supplier development initiatives aligned with business and project objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Materials Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering , or a related field.
  • Intermediate to Advanced English .
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with SAP .
  • Knowledge of sourcing processes for new products and supplier development.
  • Experience in the automotive industry and/or with productive materials and commodities is highly desirable.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects and priorities.

Required Skills

  • Negotiation skills.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Communication skills.
  • Problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in the automotive industry.
  • Knowledge of productive materials and commodities.

Salary Range & Compensation Package

We want you to feel welcomed, challenged, and inspired. That is why we have carefully designed a comprehensive benefits package focused on supporting your health and well-being, professional and personal growth, and integration into a positive and collaborative work environment.

title: Nurse Practitioners
description:
Company Description:

Curvia AI is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specializing in innovative and scalable services, Curvia AI empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We're committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.

Role Overview

We are seeking Nurse Practitioner Experts to generate, evaluate, and refine tasks related to advanced practice nursing, primary and acute care, and clinical decision-making for frontier AI initiatives. In this role, experts will build technically accurate, practical tasks that test AI model capabilities in differential diagnosis, diagnostic ordering, clinical management planning, and patient care execution.

Offer details:

  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Years Of Experience: 3-8 years
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Commitments Required: Full-time. 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Start Date: Immediate
  • Number of openings: 5
  • Pay: US $33/hr

Skill

  • Professional Experience: ~3–8 years of experience in advanced practice nursing across primary care or acute care settings. Must have actively practiced as an NP within the last 3 years to maintain current clinical relevance.
  • Credentials: Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) with active Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) licensure and regionally relevant national board certification (e.G., FNP, AGACNP, AGPCNP).
  • Core Competencies: Expertise in comprehensive patient assessments, formulation of differential diagnoses, ordering and interpreting diagnostic tests, pharmacological and non-pharmacological management planning, and acute/chronic disease management.
  • Deliverable History: Proven track record of producing advanced clinical deliverables such as comprehensive SOAP notes, diagnostic workup plans, clinical management guidelines, patient discharge summaries, and referral consultations.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Ability to synthesize complex clinical presentations, weigh competing diagnostic hypotheses, and evaluate multi-faceted treatment strategies.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong ability to review advanced clinical scenarios, patient histories, and diagnostic results to ensure precision, patient safety, and alignment with current clinical practice guidelines.
  • Communication: Excellent written communication skills for writing realistic clinical vignettes, advanced practice prompts, and structured evaluation rubrics.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently, incorporate calibration feedback, and iterate under senior review.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be part of a specialized functional pod responsible for creating high-quality training and evaluation data for AI models. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Producing expert-level tasks and gold-standard solutions in primary and acute care assessment, diagnosis, and management that meet the pod's quality bar.
  • Authoring realistic advanced-practice scenarios involving complex patient histories, physical exam findings, lab/imaging interpretation, and evidence-based treatment plans.
  • Applying rubric standards and grading frameworks set by the Functional SME (Expert) Lead.
  • Working under senior review to incorporate calibration feedback, refine outputs, and iterate on task designs.
  • Verifying that all created clinical scenarios, diagnostic data, and treatment plans are medically accurate, realistic, and compliant with current clinical standards.
  • Ensuring consistent alignment with project guidelines, quality benchmarks, and milestone deadlines.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field.
  • Experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, quality assurance, or a related analytical role is preferred but not required.

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: Consultor(A) Comercial Pj — Vendas De Nutracêuticos Rpn - Rede De Produtos Naturais | Home Office
description:
Consultor(a) Comercial PJ — Vendas de Nutracêuticos

RPN – Rede de Produtos Naturais | Home Office

Modelo: Prestação de serviços – PJ

Formato: 100% remoto

Área: Vendas / Inside Sales

Produto: Nutracêuticos e produtos naturais

Remuneração inicial: Comissão de 3% a 5% sobre vendas, conforme performance e metas

LEIA ANTES DE SE CANDIDATAR

Esta oportunidade não é para quem procura um trabalho fácil por ser home office .

Não estamos procurando pessoas que queiram “experimentar vendas”, trabalhar algumas horas quando tiverem disponibilidade ou realizar atendimentos apenas pelo celular.

Estamos procurando profissionais de vendas .

Pessoas que entendam que vender exige rotina, disciplina, acompanhamento, CRM, telefone, negociação, follow-up e principalmente constância.

Você trabalhará de casa, mas isso não significa trabalhar quando quiser .

Precisamos de alguém comprometido com uma rotina comercial consistente e com disponibilidade profissional equivalente a pelo menos 8 horas por dia , de segunda a sexta-feira, dentro da dinâmica acordada com a operação comercial.

Se você procura apenas uma renda extra eventual, esta vaga provavelmente não é adequada ao seu perfil.

Sobre a RPN

A RPN – Rede de Produtos Naturais atua no mercado de nutracêuticos e produtos naturais.

Estamos ampliando nossa operação comercial e buscamos vendedores para atender e desenvolver oportunidades geradas pela empresa.

Você não será responsável apenas pelo primeiro contato.

O profissional será responsável pelo ciclo comercial completo .

Você recebe o lead, realiza o primeiro atendimento, identifica a necessidade, apresenta os produtos, trabalha objeções, negocia, realiza follow-ups e conduz a oportunidade até o fechamento.

Como funciona a venda

Na nossa operação, nem todo cliente compra no primeiro contato.

Por isso, uma parte importante do trabalho é o acompanhamento.

Algumas negociações podem exigir:

7, 8, 10 ou até 12 contatos com o mesmo lead.

Isso pode envolver:

  • Ligação;
  • WhatsApp;
  • Áudio;
  • Retorno agendado;
  • Apresentação de produto;
  • Tratamento deobjeções;
  • Recuperação de oportunidade;
  • Follow-up.

Se você costuma entrar em contato uma ou duas vezes e depois simplesmente esperar o cliente retornar, esta vaga não é para você .

O que você fará
  • Atender leads disponibilizados pela RPN;
  • Realizar contatos comerciais por telefone e WhatsApp;
  • Entender a necessidade de cada cliente;
  • Recomendar osprodutos adequados;
  • Apresentar benefícios e diferenciais dos produtos;
  • Conduzir negociações;
  • Trabalhar objeções;
  • Realizar follow-ups;
  • Fazer entre 7e 12 contatos quando uma oportunidade exigir acompanhamento;
  • Recuperar leads que ainda não compraram;
  • Registrar todas as movimentações no CRM;
  • Atualizar tarefas, etapas e próximos contatos;
  • Administrar sua carteira de oportunidades;
  • Trabalhar o lead desde a entrada até o fechamento;
  • Cumprir metase indicadores comerciais;
  • Participar das reuniões e alinhamentos necessários da equipe;
  • Manter disponibilidade consistente durante o período comercial acordado.
Estrutura obrigatória para trabalhar

Por ser uma vaga home office, você precisa ter estrutura adequada de trabalho em casa .

É obrigatório possuir:

  • Computador ou notebook próprio;
  • Internet estável e de boa velocidade;
  • Ambiente adequado para realizar ligações e atendimentos;
  • Telefone/celular para apoio aos atendimentos;
  • Facilidade para utilizar sistemas online;
  • Disponibilidade para utilizar CRM diariamente.

Não é possível desempenhar esta função trabalhando somente pelo celular.

O computador será uma ferramenta diária de trabalho.

Perfil que buscamos

Queremos alguém que consiga trabalhar sem precisar ter uma pessoa ao lado cobrando cada atividade.

Home office exige ainda mais responsabilidade.

Procuramos profissionais:

  • Disciplinados;
  • Organizados;
  • Persistentes;
  • Comunicativos;
  • Orientados a metas;
  • Comprometidoscom resultado;
  • Que gostem devender;
  • Que saibam trabalhar com cobrança de performance;
  • Que não tenham dificuldade em ligar para clientes;
  • Que consigam realizar vários follow-ups;
  • Que saibam organizar uma carteira de leads;
  • Que tenham maturidade para trabalhar remotamente;
  • Que cumpram os compromissos assumidos com a operação.
CRM é parte do trabalho

O CRM não é opcional.

Toda oportunidade deverá estar registrada e atualizada.

Esperamos que o profissional registre:

  • Contatos realizados;
  • Respostas dosclientes;
  • Etapa da negociação;
  • Objeções;
  • Próximo contato;
  • Tarefas;
  • Resultado da oportunidade.

Para nós, venda sem registro e acompanhamento não é processo comercial .

Experiência anterior com CRM será considerada um diferencial importante.

Remuneração — atenção a esta informação

Nos primeiros 30 dias , esta oportunidade não possui remuneração fixa .

A remuneração inicial será exclusivamente baseada nas vendas realizadas.

O profissional poderá receber:

3% a 5% de comissão sobre vendas , de acordo com volume, performance e metas estabelecidas pela operação.

Queremos ser totalmente transparentes sobre esse ponto antes da candidatura.

Não queremos que alguém entre na operação esperando um salário fixo durante esse período.

E depois dos primeiros 30 dias?

Os primeiros 30 dias também funcionam como um período de avaliação prática de performance.

Avaliaremos fatores como:

  • Volume de atividades;
  • Utilização correta do CRM;
  • Qualidade dosatendimentos;
  • Quantidade defollow-ups;
  • Conversão;
  • Organização;
  • Comprometimento;
  • Cumprimento dos combinados;
  • Resultado comercial.

Profissionais que demonstrarem capacidade real de execução e performance poderão receber uma proposta comercial com componente fixo , além da remuneração variável.

Essa evolução não é automática e dependerá da avaliação dos resultados apresentados durante o período inicial.

Esta vaga NÃO é indicada para quem:
  • Procura apenas uma renda extra eventual;
  • Não possui computador;
  • Tem internet instável;
  • Pretende trabalhar apenas pelo celular;
  • Não gosta de utilizar CRM;
  • Não gosta de fazer ligações;
  • Faz um ou dois contatos e abandona o cliente;
  • Não quer trabalhar com metas;
  • Não consegue manter uma rotina profissional em home office;
  • Precisa ser constantemente cobrado para executar suas tarefas;
  • Espera remuneração fixa garantida desde o primeiro dia.
Esta vaga é indicada para quem:

Já trabalhou com vendas e sabe que resultado comercial vem de processo, volume, acompanhamento e persistência .

Se você sabe vender, gosta de trabalhar com metas, possui estrutura para home office e entende que um bom vendedor não abandona uma oportunidade depois do primeiro “não”, queremos analisar seu perfil.

Candidate-se somente se estiver de acordo com o modelo de contratação, estrutura necessária e formato de remuneração descritos nesta vaga.

Competências recomendadas no LinkedIn

Inside Sales | Vendas | Nutracêuticos | CRM | Vendas Consultivas | Follow-up | Negociação | Gestão de Pipeline | Atendimento Comercial | Vendas por Telefone | WhatsApp | Conversão de Leads | Fechamento de Vendas

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Chatfuel is expanding into Brazil, and we're looking for someone to help lead the way.

About Chatfuel

Chatfuel is an AI customer communication platform helping small and medium businesses automate conversations on WhatsApp, Instagram, and the web. We turn messages into bookings, sales, and support using no-code flows, AI agents, and built-in CRM tools. We're a remote-friendly, product-led team focused on Latin America and an official Meta partner.

About the role

You'll be the face of Chatfuel for Portuguese-speaking customers, working with both direct SMB clients and marketing agencies that manage Chatfuel for their own customers, with a strong focus on Brazil. This is a ground-floor opportunity: you'll help shape how Chatfuel enters and grows in the Brazilian market, not follow an existing playbook.

You'll work hands-on with customers to help them get the most value from Chatfuel, implement AI-powered automation into their business processes, and make sure their feedback actually reaches our Product and Marketing teams. This is a key role for us: as our "voice of the customer" in Brazil, what you learn from real businesses directly feeds our product and marketing roadmap, not just a support function on the side.

What you'll do

  • Lead product demos and customer consultations
  • Help customers implement Chatfuel, AI agents, chatbots, and automated messaging
  • Get hands-on with the platform yourself so you can guide clients through technical setup: configuring flows, integrations, and automations, not just explaining concepts
  • Help build and refine our Brazil go-to-market processes from scratch: onboarding flows, support playbooks, content, as one of the first people dedicated to this market
  • Support the creation of educational content, training materials, YouTube videos, and our knowledge base
  • Respond to customer questions and support our WhatsApp community
  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing on experiments, new funnels, and product testing
  • Collect customer feedback and help identify opportunities to improve the product

What we're looking for

  • Fluent Portuguese
  • English at B2 level or higher
  • Experience in customer service or technical support
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex things simply
  • Technical aptitude: comfortable digging into a platform's settings and configuration to solve problems hands-on, not just at a conceptual level
  • Interest in technology, AI, automation, marketing, and sales
  • Understanding of sales funnels and customer journeys
  • Comfortable working without a fixed playbook, happy to help design and iterate on processes as we build out a new market
  • Willingness to learn, experiment, and take initiative
  • Ability to work within Latin American time zones
  • Familiarity with REST APIs is a plus, but not required

What we offer

  • $1,400-$1,600 USD, depending on experience
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to successfully onboarded clients
  • Remote work in an international team
  • Hands-on experience with AI and automation technologies
  • Training, mentorship, and opportunities for professional growth

Hiring process

  1. Fill out the application. We'll review your experience, and if there's a strong match, we'll follow up with a link to a short test assignment (~60 minutes) — it helps us understand your baseline knowledge, how you approach getting things done, and your working principles
  2. Interview with the Product Manager and Customer Success Manager
  3. Final hiring decision

description:

title: Director Of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required;
    Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required;
    English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum;
    MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Social Media & Content

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 40 hours/week

About the Client

Our client is a marketing and creative agency that helps brands grow through a combination of digital marketing, social media, content creation, video production, paid media, and creative design .

The agency works with brands across different industries, developing engaging, social-first content designed to build audiences, increase brand visibility, and support business growth.

The team is currently expanding its video production capabilities to support a new college-focused social app . The project will involve creating authentic, engaging short-form content featuring college campuses, student conversations, street interviews, and promotional material.

About the Role

We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor to join the creative team and support the launch of a new social app designed for college students.

The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form social media content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

You will work with raw footage, often recorded on phones or other lightweight equipment, and turn it into polished, engaging content that feels natural to a young U.S. audience.

A strong understanding of social media culture, Gen Z content, pacing, storytelling, and current short-form video trends is important for this role.

Candidates with previous experience editing street interviews, man-on-the-street content, campus videos, interviews, UGC, or youth-oriented social content are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.
  • Turn raw phone-shot and camera footage into polished, engaging social content.
  • Edit college campus tours, street interviews, student conversations, promotional videos, and UGC-style content.
  • Review large amounts of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, reactions, quotes, and answers.
  • Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
  • Build a clear and engaging story from multiple clips.
  • Use jump cuts, hard cuts, B-roll, and pacing to maintain viewer attention.
  • Cut footage to music and beats when appropriate.
  • Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, and other social-first elements.
  • Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, pacing, and editing style across content.
  • Repurpose footage into multiple short-form pieces when appropriate.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently.
  • Manage a high volume of content during the app's launch period.
  • Potentially support video projects for other agency clients as the role develops.

Requirements

  • Proven experience editing short-form social media content .
  • Strong proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable Adobe video-editing software.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual rhythm.
  • Ability to turn raw footage into engaging short-form content.
  • Experience with basic color correction and audio editing.
  • Ability to work effectively with phone-shot, raw, and imperfect footage.
  • Good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form formats.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while taking direction and incorporating feedback.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience editing street interviews or man-on-the-street videos .
  • Experience with college, campus, student, Gen Z, lifestyle, dating, social, or UGC content.
  • Experience editing interviews and multi-person conversations.
  • Experience working with high-volume social media content.
  • Familiarity with Adobe After Effects .
  • Basic motion graphics and animation skills.
  • Experience creating engaging captions and animated text.
  • Strong awareness of current TikTok and Instagram editing trends.

The ideal candidate knows how to:

  • Start with a strong hook.
  • Remove unnecessary pauses, filler, and dead space.
  • Keep conversations moving with natural cuts and jump cuts.
  • Identify the funniest, most interesting, surprising, or relatable moments.
  • Combine multiple interview responses into a cohesive story.
  • Use B-roll strategically.
  • Add clean, readable captions.
  • Use music and sound effects when they enhance the content.
  • Keep the content authentic and conversational.
  • Avoid excessive transitions, effects, and animations when they don't add value.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) profissional para integrar nossa equipe de consultoria regulatória, atuando em projetos de elevada complexidade técnica nos setores de infraestrutura e serviços públicos.

A posição envolve participação ativa no desenvolvimento de estudos econômicos, regulatórios e analíticos, contribuindo para o desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para empresas e entidades reguladoras no Brasil e na América Latina.

Trata-se de uma oportunidade para atuar na interseção entre regulação econômica, análise de dados e estratégia, com impacto direto em políticas públicas e no desempenho de setores essenciais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Estruturar, tratar e analisar bases de dados, desenvolvendo modelos quantitativos e ferramentas analíticas para suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Desenvolver modelos de simulação econômico-financeira aplicados a contextos regulatórios;
  • Conduzir e apoiar estudos regulatórios, incluindo revisões e reajustes tarifários, com atuação em temas como base de remuneração, custos operacionais, mercado, perdas, investimentos e estrutura tarifária;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, notas metodológicas e materiais analíticos com elevado rigor técnico;
  • Apoiar a preparação de apresentações, consultas públicas e treinamentos, contribuindo para a disseminação de conhecimento técnico-regulatório;
  • Interagir com equipes multidisciplinares e stakeholders, incluindo concessionárias e agências reguladoras.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Economia, Engenharia, Estatística, Ciência de Dados, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em tratamento, análise e modelagem de dados;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação (como R ou Python) será considerado um diferencial;
  • Familiaridade com regulação econômica de serviços públicos será considerada um diferencial.

Perfil desejado

  • Raciocínio analítico e capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos;
  • Autonomia, organização e atenção a detalhes;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes projetos e ambientes;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade para elaboração de materiais técnicos;
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e interação com diferentes stakeholders.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em análise de dados, modelagem quantitativa ou desenvolvimento de modelos analíticos (requisito obrigatório);
  • Experiência prévia em projetos relacionados à regulação de serviços públicos (gás, saneamento ou energia elétrica) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência na elaboração de relatórios técnicos, estudos ou análises aplicadas a projetos será valorizada.

O que oferecemos

  • Integração a uma consultoria internacional com sólida atuação em regulação de serviços públicos na América Latina;
  • Participação direta em projetos estratégicos com impacto em políticas públicas e decisões regulatórias;
  • Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento profissional acelerado;
  • Exposição a temas de alta relevância econômica e institucional;
  • Oportunidade de contribuir para a melhoria da eficiência, sustentabilidade e acesso aos serviços públicos.

title: Supervisor de Vendas - Shopping Iguatemi Ribeirão Preto
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Tem habilidade para liderar e inspirar? Esta vaga é para você! Você vai treinar e engajar a equipe, garantir um atendimento top e cuidar da gestão do estoque, levando nosso time a marcar golaços todos os dias.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Você será responsável por executar e garantir a execução dos processos de venda do setor de calçados, prestando atendimento de qualidade e zelando pela satisfação do cliente, conforme nosso roteiro de atendimento.

Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados.
  • Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.
  • Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.
  • Realizar diariamente a reunião com o time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.
  • Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros) com os atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES ✅ ✅

Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior em andamento completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

SOBRE A CENTAURO:

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas - Aparecida - SP - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio, o dinheiro e os pagamentos na América Latina.

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.

About the Role

You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.

This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.

Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.

What You'll Own

  • E-commerce growth strategy
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
  • Customer journey & UX
  • Merchandising & pricing
  • Checkout optimization
  • A/B testing & experimentation
  • Retention (Email & SMS)
  • SEO commercial performance
  • AI-powered shopping experiences
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor.
  • Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap.
  • Lead CRO and experimentation programs.
  • Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile.
  • Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells.
  • Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
  • Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth.
  • Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value.
  • Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.

Success Metrics

You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:

  • Gross Profit
  • Profit per Visitor
  • Conversion Rate
  • Average Order Value
  • Checkout Completion
  • Repeat Purchase Rate
  • Customer Lifetime Value
  • Incremental Profit from Experiments

Requirements

  • 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce.
  • 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role.
  • Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required).
  • Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability.
  • Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization.
  • Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance.
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams.
  • Excellent English (B2+).
  • Available during Los Angeles business hours.
  • Based outside the United States.

Nice to Have

  • Multi-brand e-commerce
  • Marketplace businesses
  • High-volume online retail
  • WooCommerce or Shopify
  • AI-powered personalization
  • Behavioral psychology
  • Seasonal or event-driven commerce

This Role Is Not for Someone Who

  • Only manages website content.
  • Focuses on traffic instead of profit.
  • Relies entirely on agencies.
  • Treats CRO as visual redesign.
  • Reports problems without owning implementation.
  • Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.

What We Offer

  • Remote, long-term leadership role.
  • Direct partnership with the CEO and founders.
  • Ownership of commercial growth strategy.
  • Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
We’re Hiring: General Ledger Accountant (Financial Analysis) | Philippines

FiberHome is looking for a General Ledger Accountant with a Financial Analysis focus to join our Finance team in the Philippines and provide offshore finance support to our Brazil/Mercosur operations .

This is an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional who wants to work in a multinational, cross-cultural environment and gain exposure to Brazilian finance operations.

Location: Philippines – Remote

Working Hours: Aligned with Brazil (Brasília) business hours

Experience: 3–5 years in Accounting, General Ledger, Finance, or FP&A

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field

CPA: Philippine CPA is a plus

English: Fluent / professional working proficiency

Portuguese: Not required at entry, but willingness to learn Portuguese is mandatory

ERP: Experience with ERP systems required; TOTVS (Protheus) is a strong advantage

About the Role

As a General Ledger Accountant , you will be responsible for the full accounting close cycle, including monthly and year-end closing, journal entries, account reconciliations, and monthly financial reporting.

The role also includes a financial analysis component , supporting management with financial performance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, cost analysis, and operational reporting.

You will work closely with colleagues in Brazil, China, and Argentina , making strong communication, attention to detail, organization, and cross-cultural collaboration essential.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage the monthly and annual accounting closing process, including closing schedules, checklists, and follow-up of outstanding items.

• Prepare, review, and maintain journal entries, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and traceability.

• Perform account reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and prepare reconciliation reports.

• Prepare and deliver monthly financial statements and management reports.

• Support internal and external audits by providing accounting data and documentation.

• Ensure accounting activities comply with company policies, internal controls, and applicable accounting standards, including Brazilian local requirements.

• Prepare financial analyses and management reports to support business decision-making.

• Monitor financial KPIs and recommend corrective actions where necessary.

• Analyze operating expenses, costs, and profitability.

• Support annual budgeting and periodic forecasting.

• Support AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and cash-flow forecasting.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and strengthen internal controls.

• Operate and support the implementation, configuration, and optimization of TOTVS (Protheus) .

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 3–5 years of professional experience in accounting, General Ledger, finance, or FP&A.

• Hands-on experience with:

  • Month-end and year-end closing
  • Journal entries
  • Account reconciliations
  • Financial statement preparation
  • Financial analysis and reporting
  • Budgeting and forecasting
  • Cash-flow management
  • AP/AR
  • Bank reconciliation

• Experience with an ERP system.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Familiarity with applicable accounting standards and compliance requirements. IFRS knowledge is preferred.

• Experience supporting multinational or offshore/shared-service teams is a plus, particularly exposure to Latin America or Brazil .

• Knowledge of FX operations and international trade is a plus.

• Fluent English for professional communication.|

Important Requirements

This position supports our Brazil subsidiary , so successful candidates must:

Be willing to work according to Brazil (Brasília) business hours , including evening/night shifts in the Philippines.

Be committed to learning Portuguese after joining . Existing Portuguese or Spanish knowledge is a strong advantage.

Be willing to learn and become proficient in TOTVS (Protheus) , the Brazilian local finance system.

Be comfortable working remotely with colleagues from China, Brazil, and Argentina .

What Success Looks Like

Your performance will be measured through:

• Timely and accurate month-end/year-end closing

• Accuracy of journal entries and account reconciliations

• Timely and accurate monthly financial reporting

• Cash-flow forecast accuracy and payment timeliness

• Progress toward Portuguese and TOTVS learning milestones

• Cost-saving and financial efficiency initiatives

Why Join Us?

This role offers the opportunity to:

Work in a multinational and cross-cultural finance environment

Gain exposure to Brazilian and Latin American finance operations

Develop both GL accounting and financial analysis expertise

Gain experience with TOTVS (Protheus)

Work closely with regional finance teams and management

Interested? Apply now or send your CV to us.

title: Clinical Research Associate
description:
Job Title: Clinical Research Associate (CRA)

Contract: 12-Month Fixed - Brazil

Start: To be Confirmed (Pipeline Opportunity)

Organisation: Leading global life sciences company (via Kelly FSP)

Location: Brazil (Hybrid)

Job Overview:

Kelly is pipelining talent for an evergreen CRA role in pharma. If you’re looking for a project-based career as a CRA, we’d love to have a preliminary conversation, connect with us to explore future opportunities!

This is a pipeline opportunity for proactive candidates interested in joining a global leader in the life sciences industry.

The Clinical Research Associate (CRA) is responsible for overseeing clinical trials and ensuring compliance with protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and regulatory requirements. The CRA monitors the progress of clinical studies conducted at investigative sites and ensures that data is collected, recorded, and reported accurately.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct site visits (initiation, monitoring, and closeout) to ensure adherence to study protocols and regulatory requirements.
  • Verify that study data and documentation are accurate, complete, and maintained according to GCP.
  • Identify, resolve, and escalate site issues related to protocol compliance or subject safety.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the sponsor and investigative sites.
  • Review and collect essential documents for the Trial Master File.
  • Train and support site staff on study procedures and protocol requirements.
  • Ensure timely reporting of adverse events and deviations.
  • Assist in subject recruitment and retention strategies.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate monitoring reports and documentation.
  • Communicate findings and follow-up activities to stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, or relevant field (required).
  • Prior experience as a CRA or in clinical research (3-7 years)
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant regulatory guidelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to travel frequently.

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) platforms.
  • Problem-solving and conflict resolution.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • 3-7 years as a CRA

Why Join?

  • Opportunity to join a globally recognised life sciences company through Kelly’s FSP model.
  • Work with international experts on high-impact projects.
  • Gain global exposure and expand your clinical knowledge.
  • Be part of a collaborative, growth-focused work culture.
  • Pipeline opportunity with anticipated hiring in the near future, apply early to be considered once the position is formally approved and released.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)

$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses

We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.

Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.

What You'll Actually Do

High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.

Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data

Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.

Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.

AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.

Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)

Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency

Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback

Why Top Editors Choose Us:

Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.

Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.

See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.

Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.

High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.

Application Process:

Step 1: Submit Application

  • Current CV/resume
  • Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted)
  • Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked

Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.

Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.

Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.

Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.

Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

title: Structural Analysis Engineer - Mid Level
description:
Summary Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level Structural Analysis Engineer to support aerospace and/or aeronautical engineering projects, with a focus on metallic and/or composite structures. The engineer will be responsible for performing static analysis, fatigue analysis, and damage tolerance evaluations to support product development, certification, modifications, and in-service support activities.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in structural calculations, interpretation of technical requirements, engineering drawings, finite element modeling, and technical report preparation. A solid understanding of strength of materials, structural mechanics, margins of safety, and structural substantiation methods is required.

Key Responsibilities:

- Perform static analysis of aircraft structures using hand calculations and/or finite element methods.

- Support fatigue and structural life assessments under technical guidance.

- Support damage tolerance evaluations, including crack growth assessment and inspection criteria.

- Prepare finite element models, loads, boundary conditions, and basic correlation activities.

- Prepare clear and traceable technical reports aligned with certification requirements.

- Interface with design, loads, materials, certification, manufacturing, and product support teams.

Desired Qualifications:

- Degree in Aeronautical, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

- Approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in structural analysis.

- Experience with tools such as Nastran, Patran, FEMAP, HyperMesh, Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar.

- Experience with metallic and/or composite aircraft structures.

- Knowledge of static strength, fatigue, damage tolerance, structural margins, and certification documentation.

- Technical English for reading, report writing, and engineering communication.
